title: Standardize enterprise admin request intake & scoring rubric for RBAC/SSO/SCIM
creator: Maya Chen
description: Create a standardized intake form and priority scoring rubric for enterprise admin & access management requests (RBAC role changes, SSO/SAML integrations, SCIM provisioning, org policy/audit asks). Goal is to reduce back-and-forth, route requests to the correct owner (self-service docs, Customer Success, Engineering/Infra, Security/Legal), and provide predictable SLAs for enterprise customers.
acceptance_criteria: A single intake form (Zendesk + webhook) that maps to Linear tickets with PM labels and priority score
A documented scoring rubric (security risk, compliance impact, engineering effort, revenue/contract impact, data residency) published in Confluence
Routing rules implemented for 4 outcomes: self-serve docs, CS/sales-assisted, infra engineering work, security/legal review
Sample runbook and SLA commitments for each routing outcome (e.g., 3 business days for CS triage, 10 business days for infra work estimate)
Instrumented metrics: time-to-first-response, routing accuracy, downstream engineering backlog impact tracked in dashboard
comments: 2025-11-05 Maya Chen: Created ticket after multiple customers reported inconsistent RBAC onboarding and long SSO integration lead times. Collected ~12 incoming requests from Nov-Oct support queue for pattern analysis.

2025-11-20 Jonas Meyer: Spiked scoring matrix options; initial weights proposed (security 30%, compliance 25%, engineering effort 20%, commercial impact 15%, data residency 10%). Shared with Security and CS for feedback.

2025-12-02 Priya Rao (Security): Threat model suggested raising security weight on SAML metadata exchanges for enterprise IdPs. Flag: require security_review_required for any IdP that requests certificate sharing.
2026-01-10 Ana Lopez (Customer Success): Recommend two-step customer-facing flow: pre-intake checklist + intake form to reduce incomplete requests (reduces hold time by ~40% in pilot).
2026-01-22 Jonas Meyer: Drafted Confluence doc and sample Zendesk form (link in Links). Beginning integration spike with infra webhook (ENG-4321).
2026-02-05 Legal review (T. Nguyen): SCIM provisioning terms need a short addendum for some EEA customers; suggested template language included in Confluence doc.
2026-02-18 Maya Chen: Ran a 10-customer pilot of the rubric; routing accuracy 82% vs manual routing baseline 61%. CS reported fewer ambiguous tickets. Planning rollout to 50 customers for March.
2026-02-20 Jonas Meyer: Updated ticket with engineering bandwidth estimates and blocked item: final mapping of Zendesk fields -> Linear labels (waiting on Zendesk admin config).
decision_log: 2025-12-15: Adopted weighted scoring rubric (security/compliance > commercial) after Security and Sales sync. Rationale: security/compliance failures create disproportionate legal/regulatory risk.
2026-01-12: Routing model chosen: if score >= 80 -> Eng/Infra assessment; 50-79 -> CS + PM triage; <50 -> self-serve + docs. Trade-off: higher false positives for Eng to avoid missed high-risk items.
2026-02-01: Chose Zendesk -> webhook -> Linear approach instead of building custom intake in Console to ship faster and leverage existing CS workflows.
2026-02-10: Decided to require security review flag for any SAML/IdP work that requests private certificate exchange or assertion-relay changes.
next_steps: Finalize Zendesk field mapping and enable webhook to create Linear tickets (owner: Jonas)
Publish Confluence rubric and checklist; create CS short training doc and CS playbook (owner: Maya)
Add triage dashboard in Looker for routing accuracy & time-to-first-response (owner: Analytics)
Schedule cross-functional sign-off (Security, Legal, CS, Eng) week of 2026-02-24
